aggregation: verify.py groups 14 unit-weight checks into 5 static, 6 reward_hacking, and 3 partial_oracle checks. It takes the unweighted mean within each bucket and applies the canonical blend: reward = (total_static_check_score * 1 + total_reward_hacking_check_score * 2 + total_partial_oracle_check_score * 3) / 6. Content (reward_hacking + partial_oracle) therefore supplies 5/6 (83%) of reward and structural 1/6 (17%), inside the 40% structural ceiling. Every check scores independently in [0,1]: no gate, no cap, and no multiplier of one check by another. reward.json reports exactly the four required numeric fields - reward, total_static_check_score, total_reward_hacking_check_score, total_partial_oracle_check_score - and the per-check breakdown of name, score, notes, and bucket is printed to stdout and the test log rather than into reward.json. LLM judge calls use W&B Inference (WANDB_API_KEY, moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6) and print per-company graded booleans, justification, and LLM_JUDGE_STATUS lines; missing key or total call failure is labelled LLM_JUDGE_STATUS=skipped and scores 1.0 (canonical county-service skip contract), while per-company content failures still score 0.

static_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Scores the share of expected ticker files that have a non-empty brief under /logs/agent/briefs/<ticker>.md.
static_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks a tiny completed subset from looking like a finished book.

static_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For each of the six required section headings, requires the heading to appear as a markdown line and to be followed by at least 25 words of body text before the next heading.
static_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks heading-string stuffing without organized section content.

static_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Requires the first non-blank line of the brief to be a level-1 heading that names the ticker (and company identity after accent folding).
static_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks untitled, late, or buried headings that do not open the document.

static_checks_4.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Requires at least 250 words and a unique-word ratio of at least 0.28 so repeated filler cannot pad past the floor.
static_checks_4.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks stub files and boilerplate padding.

static_checks_5.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Confirms briefs live under /logs/agent/briefs/ and that /input_artifacts/ was not modified or polluted with extra agent files.
static_checks_5.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Enforces the instruction's deliverable-path and input-immutability requirements.

reward_hacking_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Requires company name, ticker, filing year, and at least one governance/compensation-bearing (topical) multi-word span drawn from the proxy body after the short header, not header echo or arbitrary copied text.
reward_hacking_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks header-only identity restatement without reading the filing body.

reward_hacking_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Averages (a) presence of at least two governance/compensation-bearing verbatim 6-word spans from the proxy body with (b) an anti-copy score that is zero when total 6-gram verbatim overlap exceeds 15% of the brief.
reward_hacking_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks both reputation-only briefs and bulk verbatim dumps that satisfy span checks as a side effect.

reward_hacking_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Averages a full-document (untruncated) cross-brief bigram-overlap template score with the share of briefs that carry a topical governance/compensation span from their own proxy, so distinct-but-ungrounded briefs cannot pass on cross-brief distinctness alone.
reward_hacking_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks a memo copied across the book and blocks briefs that ignore their own filing.

reward_hacking_checks_4.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Scores paraphrase discipline (verbatim overlap under the copy cap), reasoning applied to a governance/compensation claim in the same sentence within the board and voting-takeaway sections, and presence of a body-specific token not present in the proxy header.
reward_hacking_checks_4.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Requires synthesis beyond mechanical reproduction of handed header/body text.

reward_hacking_checks_5.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Independent non-agent-family LLM (W&B Inference, moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6, keyed by WANDB_API_KEY) grades identity, governance, compensation, and say-on-pay/related-party grounding per company against frozen proxy excerpts, returning booleans plus a short justification printed per ticker. Missing WANDB_API_KEY or a total call failure is labelled LLM_JUDGE_STATUS=skipped and the check is excluded from penalty (score 1.0), matching the canonical county-service verifier contract.
reward_hacking_checks_5.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks keyword-stuffed or wrong-company briefs that deterministic span checks alone cannot fully assess.

reward_hacking_checks_6.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Independent non-agent-family LLM (W&B Inference, moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6, keyed by WANDB_API_KEY) grades company-specific depth across board independence, pay design, pay-for-performance, say-on-pay, related-party treatment, voting takeaway, specificity, and contradiction avoidance, returning booleans plus a short justification printed per ticker. Missing WANDB_API_KEY or a total call failure is labelled LLM_JUDGE_STATUS=skipped and the check is excluded from penalty (score 1.0), matching the canonical county-service verifier contract.
reward_hacking_checks_6.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks thin restatements that never reach a company-specific voting reading.

partial_oracle_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the held-out subset, requires company/ticker/filing-year identification plus body-level content (distinctive phrase hit or body span), not header echo alone.
partial_oracle_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks misidentified or header-only briefs on the held-out set.

partial_oracle_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Scores the hit rate of hand-verified distinctive phrases for the held-out subset, discounted when the brief is a bulk verbatim dump of the proxy body.
partial_oracle_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks briefs that never absorb company-specific proxy content, and discounts copy-paste dumps.

partial_oracle_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the held-out subset, requires complete six-section bodies, length plus lexical diversity, at least two distinct governance terms inside the board section and two distinct compensation terms inside the executive-compensation section, PLUS company-specific grounding (a hand-verified distinctive phrase or a topical span from this proxy's body) so generic vocabulary alone does not pass.
partial_oracle_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks heading shells and generic keyword stuffing outside the relevant sections.
